Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine();
    final urls = <String>['https://example.com/good1', 'https://example.com/bad', 'https://example.com/good2'];
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.batchScrape(engine, urls);
    stdout.writeln(result.completedCount);
    stdout.writeln(result.failedCount);
    stdout.writeln(result.totalCount);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
